title: Where the charts find the engine and Graphviz
summary: Every chart script finds drag-lint.exe and dot.exe by -Engine/-Dot, env, settings.json, the installed layout, then the shared defaults
intro: Point the charts at a different engine or Graphviz without editing a script: pass -Engine / -Dot, set DRAGLINT_ENGINE / DRAGLINT_DOT, or put engine / dot keys in %APPDATA%\drag-lint\settings.json. A path you set that does not exist is an error naming where it was set; nothing set means the installed layout, then the shared defaults.
